text:
[title] Serving LLMs faster: 2.4x goodput at p99
[body] Alex Rivera
[body] Systems Group

novice.takeaway: This is a title slide introducing a talk about making large language model serving 2.4 times more efficient by some measure called goodput at p99.
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants us to believe their method significantly speeds up serving of LLMs.

peer.takeaway: The presentation will describe work that achieved a 2.4x improvement in serving throughput for large language models at the 99th percentile latency.
questions: What baseline is the 2.4x improvement compared against?
What system or technique achieves this improvement?
peer.inferred_claim: The presenter wants the audience to believe their system significantly improves LLM serving performance.

expert.takeaway: This is a title slide claiming a 2.4x improvement in p99 goodput for LLM serving, with no supporting details yet.
questions: What baseline is the 2.4x goodput improvement measured against?
What system or technique achieves this improvement?
expert.inferred_claim: The presenter wants the audience to expect a talk demonstrating a 2.4x p99 goodput improvement in LLM serving.

metrics.intent: Our serving system delivers 2.4x higher goodput at p99 latency by pairing PagedAttention-style KV-cache management with speculative decoding.
